title: Dharavi redevelopment explained: who gets a free 350 sq ft flat and who pays for it
description:
Dharavi in Mumbai: up to 10 lakh people (estimates) in about 2.39 sq km. The May 2025 master plan has 58,532 homes plus 13,468 commercial units. Eligible ground-floor families from before 1 Jan 2000 get a 350 sq ft flat inside Dharavi at no cost; 2000 to 2011 residents pay ₹2.5 lakh. About 9.5 crore sq ft of rehab homes must be built before about 13 crore sq ft of saleable space; Phase 1 promises 10,000 homes in about 18 months.

Sources: Business Standard (9 Jun 2025), Business Today (13 Jul 2026), Free Press Journal, Oneindia, ANI. Population figures are estimates. Some scenes are AI visualisation, not actual photos of Dharavi. Educational content, not advice.
